description: This file defines the LaunchFragment class, which is a Fragment subclass for managing UI related to launching an intent in an Android application. It handles creating the view, initializing a ViewModel, and handling menu actions to launch an activity.

classes.name: LaunchFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that provides UI for creating and launching Intents within an Android app. It manages view creation, options menu actions, and communicates intent launches via a callback.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and returns the fragment's view layout, initializing the IntentBuilderView and setting up the callback interface.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the ViewModel related to the parent activity.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Hides the FAB action when the fragment resumes.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for launching intent actions.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically the launch action which invokes the callback to start an activity with an intent.
